- Procurement asked for a standard vendor packet + Redwood W-9 and wiring instructions.
- Key decision: will Novum pay via PO/invoice or use a corporate card / marketplace purchase?

2) Can you confirm which payment path Novum prefers (PO/invoice with net terms vs card vs marketplace)? If PO, please share any vendor onboarding form or portal link — I see you mentioned a vendor packet in the call.
3) If Novum requires a vendor packet filled out, please attach that (we can route it through Ben in Sales Ops or Monica in Commercial Ops depending on which fields are required).
4) Target timeline: if procurement can confirm path and return the vendor packet this week, we can complete activation the following week.

Attachments: W9_Redwood_Inference.pdf (attached), Bank_Instructions_Sheet.pdf (attached)

I'll stand up a brief mutual action plan once you confirm the payment path.

Thanks — Laura

Laura — thanks for the clear recap.

Short answers for procurement: we prefer to onboard vendors via PO/invoice (Net 30) where possible. Our procurement team will not use a marketplace for this engagement unless there is a strong reason to.

I attached Novum's vendor intake spreadsheet (Novum_Vendor_Packet.xlsx) — it has our vendor code fields and tax classification section. Please have your ops/finance team populate the highlighted tabs and return.

Outstanding from our side:
- We need your Redwood W-9 (you included it; thank you) and explicit bank wiring / ACH instructions to provide to AP.
- Please confirm Redwood's standard invoice cadence and whether you can accept a monthly consolidated invoice for the pilot.

I copied Daniel (AP lead) for routing; he may have additional format requests.
